tasks.title: Add core.Named
steps: Write TS-22-1..TS-22-6 in a new core/named_test.go (package core_test, or package core reusing the existing `names` helper from toolpolicy_test.go; never redeclare `names`) and confirm they fail. TS-22-6 is a property test (testing/quick or a seeded random generator) that also calls Named concurrently from several goroutines; run it under -race.
Declare `func Named(ts []Tool, names ...string) ([]Tool, error)` in core/tool.go next to ReachableTools, about 20 code lines, using only fmt, strings and slices.

Build the result as `make([]Tool, 0, len(names))` (non-nil, empty with no names); for each name find the FIRST top-level tool in ts with an exactly equal Name (never search ReachableTools) and append a value copy.

Collect all missing names in names order; if any, return nil and `core: no tool named "a", "b"; the set holds: x, y` (ts order; say the set is empty when ts is empty). Single-name format must equal `core: no tool named "no_such_tool"; the set holds: read_file, write_file`.
If all names are present but one repeats, return nil and an error beginning `core: ` quoting the first repeated name (first name whose second occurrence appears earliest in names).
Keep the function pure (no package state) so it is concurrency safe; add a doc comment.

tasks.title: Add sandbox.Open: create, sync, tools, nil provider, Create failure
steps: In the sandbox module, create sandbox/open_test.go (package sandbox_test) with a recording test double implementing sandbox.Provider and sandbox.Sandbox (records call order, ctx, args, Close count; configurable Create/Sync/Tools/Close errors). Write TS-22-15 (order Create,Sync,Tools once each; Create got spec; Sync got src; Tools got opts; returned sandbox == the one Create returned; proxies are Tools' slice; Close zero times; ctx value passes through), TS-22-16 (nil src skips Sync), TS-22-18 (nil Provider: nil,nil, error beginning `sandbox: `, no panic), TS-22-19 (Create error returned identically, no sandbox method called). Add TS-22-17 in a local-provider test file (skip on Windows; set TMPDIR to t.TempDir(); use local.Unisolated() and a spec with Network.Mode NetworkUnrestricted; host dir with src/main.go): Open with LocalDir, proxy Names equal a later sb.Tools call, read_file proxy returns the file text, then second Sync, Export to host dir and Close succeed. Confirm they fail.
Create sandbox/open.go with `func Open(ctx context.Context, p Provider, spec Spec, src Source, opts ToolOptions) (Sandbox, []core.Tool, error)`.
If p == nil return nil,nil,`fmt.Errorf("sandbox: Open needs a Provider")`-style error. Call p.Create(ctx, spec); on error return nil,nil,err unchanged.
If src != nil call sb.Sync(ctx, src) and discard the SyncResult; then sb.Tools(ctx, opts). Return sb exactly as Create returned it (no wrapper) and the proxies.

For this task the failure path after Create may already do the minimal cleanup via a small helper `closeAfter(ctx, sb, stepErr)`; task 5 tests its full contract. Doc comment: ctx bounds the three calls only; the caller closes the sandbox; GitRepo works because Sync precedes Tools.

tasks.title: Make sandbox.Open close the sandbox on failure
steps: Extend sandbox/open_test.go (test double from task 4; make it record ctx.Err() and a ctx.Value seen by Close) with TS-22-20 (Sync fails with S / Tools fails with T, Close ok: (nil,nil,err==step error), Close called exactly once, Tools never called in the Sync case), TS-22-21 (step error plus Close error: errors.Is matches both, Close once), TS-22-22 (ctx carrying a value then cancelled, and an expired deadline: Close sees ctx.Err()==nil and the original value; errors.Is matches step error), TS-22-23 (property over step in {Sync,Tools}, sentinel in {ErrUnsupported, ErrToolMismatch, ErrUnsafeArchive, ErrProtocol, ErrUnavailable} wrapped with fmt.Errorf %w, Close ok or failing: errors.Is(err, X) and, if Close failed, errors.Is(err, closeErr)).

Add TS-22-24 and TS-22-25 in sandbox/open_local_test.go (skip on Windows; TMPDIR=t.TempDir(); local.Unisolated()): GitRepo source gives nil,nil, errors.Is ErrUnsupported; relative SpillDir "rel" with a LocalDir source gives an error containing `sandbox: agent refused Tools`; in both, TMPDIR/agentkit-sandbox-local is absent or has no entries. Confirm tests fail where behaviour is missing.

In sandbox/open.go, on a Sync or Tools error call sb.Close(context.WithoutCancel(ctx)) exactly once. If Close returns nil return (nil,nil,stepErr) unchanged (same value, not wrapped); otherwise return (nil,nil,errors.Join(stepErr, closeErr)).
Never call Close on success and do not retain ctx.
